name: Metro Medical Equipment & Supply, Inc.
old_description: Metro Medical Equipment & Supply, established in 1985, has a history of supplying Federal, State and Local Government healthcare facilities with medical equipment and supplies. Whether you are a manufacturer of medical devices or a government contract officer looking to place an order, Metro Medical is here to meet your needs.
about:
Metro Medical Equipment & Supply, Inc. is headquartered in St. Ann, Missouri. Founded in 1985, the company has served federal, state, and local government healthcare facilities for decades. In 2015, Karen Moore assumed ownership and now leads as President and CEO. The business is certified as a woman-owned small business and also operates as a minority-owned enterprise.

The company distributes medical equipment and supplies from established manufacturers to government buyers. Its services include contract management, lead generation, solicitation support, and regulatory compliance guidance (FAR/DFARS/VFAR, BAA/TAA). Metro Medical acts as a bridge between medical device manufacturers and government procurement offices, handling communication, quote preparation, and order fulfillment. The team uses customized software for competitive and historic sales analysis to identify opportunities.

Primary customers are U.S. government healthcare facilities, including VA Medical Centers, military hospitals, Indian Health Service centers, the National Institutes of Health, and other federal, state, and local agencies. Product categories span sports medicine and orthopedics, ophthalmology, trauma and battlefield equipment, cardiology, audiology, hematology, durable medical equipment, and imaging supplies. The firm also represents manufacturers in electromedical apparatus, surgical instruments, and medical wholesale distribution.

Metro Medical emphasizes its expertise in government procurement regulations and contract vehicles, positioning itself as a small-business link that helps manufacturers navigate federal acquisition requirements. The company states its mission is to provide the best medical support for military personnel and their families, and to be the trusted choice for government contract officers and manufacturing partners.
